title: Hoodlum Soldier Ep 24: Still Here

scenes.say: His bedroom. Night. Ali kneels in prayer. First time ever.
scenes.visual: a man kneeling beside a bed in prayer at night, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: I didn't know what to say. But I knew what I needed. Peace.
scenes.visual: a window with moonlight over a kneeling silhouette, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Church. Ali gets baptized. The pastor helps him rise.
scenes.visual: a man rising from baptism water in a church, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Rebirth ain't always easy. But it's always worth it.
scenes.visual: water drops in light, close up, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: A vet support group. I got nothin' left. You got breath. That's more than some had.
scenes.visual: two men hugging tightly in a support group, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Real strength ain't silence. It's connection.
scenes.visual: a circle of chairs in a warm room, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: A backyard barbecue. Doc: You still overcook chicken, bruh!
scenes.visual: a backyard barbecue with smoke rising, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Ali turns. Doc and Q. Alive and well. Laughter erupts.
scenes.visual: three men laughing at a grill, seen from behind, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: We made it. Somehow. Some way.
scenes.visual: kids running around a backyard at sunset, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

scenes.say: Follow for the final episode. Turn negative into positive.
scenes.visual: a grill glowing at dusk, cinematic film still, moody color grade, no text

caption: HOODLUM SOLDIER, Episode 24 of 25: Still Here. From the screenplay by Elvin Torres Sr. New episode every 48 hours.
